evals.name: contract-phase
evals.expected_output: Defines the digest data model as types (entry, per-feed group, digest, and settings) rather than leaving them implicit
assertions: Defines the digest data model as types (entry, per-feed group, digest, and settings) rather than leaving them implicit
Creates the module/file layout for the digest logic that phase 2 will fill in
Every function that will eventually hold logic raises a loud stub (NotImplementedError), never a silent default like return None/[]/""
Implements no digest business logic: no window filtering, grouping, sorting, or cap/omitted counting anywhere in the diff
Introduces no I/O: no httpx/requests/urllib, no open(), no os.environ, no datetime.now() in the new modules
Window and per-feed cap are modeled as configuration values passed in, not read from the environment
Tests added cover the data models only (construction, defaults, immutability, serialization) and assert no digest behavior
The package imports and type-checks cleanly; existing tests still pass
States plainly that this is the contract phase and that logic is deliberately deferred

evals.name: core-phase
evals.expected_output: build_digest and summarize_group are fully implemented; no NotImplementedError remains in digest.py
assertions: build_digest and summarize_group are fully implemented; no NotImplementedError remains in digest.py
digest.py reaches nothing outside its arguments: no os.environ, no open(), no httpx/requests, no datetime.now()/time.time()
The current time is used from the `now` parameter rather than read from the clock
cli.py and config.py are left stubbed — phase 3 work is not started
Unit tests for the digest logic are added
Those tests need no mocking or patching of the filesystem, network, or clock
The full test suite passes
Digest behavior is correct: window filter, newest-first ordering, per-feed cap with an accurate omitted count, failed feeds carried through with their error, empty feeds dropped

evals.name: unphased-feature
evals.prompt: add an export feature to this cli — i want to dump bookmarks out as json or csv, with filters for tag and for a date range, and it should either write to a file or go to stdout so i can pipe it
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the work has phases and says which phase this delivery is, rather than treating it as one undifferentiated change
assertions: Recognizes the work has phases and says which phase this delivery is, rather than treating it as one undifferentiated change
Defines the export contract as types/signatures (format, filter criteria, destination) before or separately from the implementation
Filtering and formatting logic is separated from I/O: those functions take bookmarks and criteria as arguments
No sqlite connection, file path, or open() appears inside the filtering or formatting functions
The CLI/edge layer is where the database, output file, and stdout are touched
Any work deferred to a later phase is recorded explicitly rather than silently dropped
Whatever is delivered is internally complete: it imports, tests pass, and no silent stub is left behind pretending to work
